ValidationRule.description: This validation rule prevent the user editing on the Closed record. Update for AZD-259116 - 2/14/2024
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.CaseValidations__c ) , NOT( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) ) , $Profile.Name <> 'Data Migration' , ISPICKVAL( Status , 'ReOpened' ) , IsClosed, ( NSP_Date_Closed__c < ( TODAY() - 91 ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Can't Reopen the Case that Closed 90 days ago
